baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negative-interrogative address and the seeing verb at focus word 2.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse does more than report a past act: it recruits the addressee as an observer who must convert either sight or reflective knowledge into recognition of the manner of the act.

activation_trace.role: The branch permits both sensory and inward perception, making the demanded recognition evidentiary rather than dependent on direct eyewitnessing.
The alerting formula turns the past event into a present challenge to state what its manner discloses.

changed_reading.before: A report that the Lord acted against a past people.
changed_reading.after: A summons to reconstruct the manner of that act as presently available evidence and to answer for what one perceives in it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The action verb at word 4 is immediately governed by the relational title at word 5.
baseline_models.mechanism: Bringing an act into being is attributed not to an unnamed force but to the addressee's Lord, whose branch inventory holds authority together with staged nurture and completion. Destructive force and continuous governance therefore remain in tension inside the same clause.

activation_trace.role: The branch anchors a concrete bringing-about, so the focus concerns an effected deed rather than a detached divine attribute.
Ownership and governing authority identify the actor as one entitled to administer the order being acted upon.
Stagewise nurture, repair, and completion keep administration and correction live alongside sovereign force.

changed_reading.before: The Lord simply inflicted an overwhelming deed.
changed_reading.after: The deed is an exercise of governing lordship, leaving open whether its severity removes, repairs, completes, or reorders what had resisted proper administration.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The proper name at focus word 6, while remaining a proper name, is supplied inside a split inventory that also carries return, recurrence, and antiquity.
baseline_models.mechanism: The named people are historically fixed by the proper-name branch, yet the same packet inventory lets the name retain a faint acoustic-semantic wake of coming back and of the ancient road. The event can therefore function not only as an extinct episode but as an old pattern repeatedly brought back before the hearer.

activation_trace.role: The proper-name branch fixes the immediate referent and prevents the resonance from replacing the named people.
Return and repetition supply a latent recurrence image through which the old event may be made present again.
The ancient-road image makes the named case readable as a well-worn historical route rather than an isolated curiosity.

changed_reading.before: The final word only identifies the people who received the deed.
changed_reading.after: The proper name still identifies them, but it also faintly presents their fate as an ancient pattern made to return to attention.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence trains perception through rupture into light, pairing and singleness, nocturnal passage, and finally reason as a restraining faculty. The focus question then tests whether the addressee can see a moral-historical pattern with the same disciplined discrimination.

activation_trace.role: Reflective judgment anchors the focus as an act of interpretation rather than mere retinal seeing.
Daybreak emerging from night supplies the first transition by which what was concealed becomes discriminable.
Joining one thing to its counterpart supplies relational comparison as a mode of recognition.
The unpaired single supplies contrast, requiring perception to distinguish what stands alone from what forms a pair.
Uncovering after passage makes the moving night a process of disclosure rather than a static darkness.
The restraining intellect supplies the faculty that converts the preceding contrasts into judgment.

structural_cues: 89:1-5 forms a pre-focus oath sequence that moves through temporal and numerical contrasts and ends by asking whether they suffice for a possessor of reason.
The branchless focus root ك ي ف is used only as the interrogative hinge that asks for manner; no branch identity is assigned to it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies emergence, contrast, passage, uncovering, and restraining reason; I infer that their sequence exercises the kind of perception demanded at 89:6. A live alternative is that the oath sequence solemnizes the claim without prescribing a perceptual method.

changed_reading.before: The addressee is asked whether a known event has been noticed.
changed_reading.after: The addressee, already trained by alternating signs, is examined on whether disciplined perception can detect how judgment emerges through history.

context_deltas.mechanism: Supports, measured making, penetrative cutting, massive rock, and driven anchors assemble an image of deliberately engineered permanence. Against that material system, the focus action becomes the overruling of a civilization's techniques for making power stand.

activation_trace.role: The focus verb supplies the effective deed that acts upon the constructed order disclosed by the following examples.
Propping a thing with a support supplies structural dependence beneath an appearance of height and durability.
Measurement and proportion frame the unparalleled built form as planned rather than accidental.
A cut that penetrates through matter supplies the technical capacity to master resistant terrain.
Great solid rock supplies the resistant material on which that mastery displays itself.
Peg-like upright fixity completes the image of political and material power designed to remain standing.

structural_cues: 89:7-10 expands the named case through Iram and then places it beside two other monumental powers.
The repeated relative descriptions foreground what these powers built, cut, and fixed before their moral excess is named.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies supports, measure, penetrative cutting, rock, and fixity; I infer that the Lord's deed targets the claim of permanence encoded by that system. The alternative is that these details only measure the peoples' strength and thus the magnitude of their defeat.

changed_reading.before: The deed is punishment of a very powerful people.
changed_reading.after: The deed exposes the contingency of engineered permanence: every support, cut surface, and anchor remains administratively vulnerable to the Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The contextual chain pictures transgression as an overflow beyond limit and corruption as departure from balance; the response is poured down as a mixed scourge under continuous watch. The focus act can therefore be read as a counter-flow that arrests and re-bounds an uncontrolled social flow.

activation_trace.role: Repair and administration anchor the inferred counter-flow as restoration of order, not free-floating fluid imagery.
Overtopping water supplies a material model for power exceeding its proper boundary.
Departure from soundness identifies the social result of that excess as systemic disequilibrium.
Pouring gives the answering action a descending flow that formally reverses the earlier rise beyond bounds.
Mixing supplies composition and calibration to the poured response rather than an undifferentiated blow.
Ongoing watch closes the mechanism by presenting the response as observant and timed.

structural_cues: 89:11-14 gives a causal sequence: exceeded bounds, multiplied corruption, poured response, then the declaration of watchfulness.
The focus possessive relation recurs in 89:13-14, keeping the counter-flow attached to the same lordship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies overflow, loss of balance, pouring, mixture, and surveillance; I supply the directional claim that the descending response reverses and bounds the prior excess. The live alternative is the simpler punitive idiom of a poured whip with no hydrological symmetry.

changed_reading.before: The Lord's action is an overpowering punishment.
changed_reading.after: The action also behaves like a watched, calibrated counter-flow that meets boundary-breaking excess with a force that reimposes bounds.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later paired trials expose a recurrent human error: converting expanded provision into a verdict of honor and constrained provision into a verdict of humiliation. Failure to honor the cut-off dependent and consumption of inherited wealth show that this bad causal reading becomes social practice. The focus command to see is thus also an audit of how one attributes meaning to the Lord's acts.

activation_trace.role: Reflective judgment anchors the focus in the quality of the observer's conclusion, not merely access to an event.
Administration and nurture make varying conditions intelligible as managed processes rather than immediate rankings of human worth.
A test that makes an inner condition visible explains why both abundance and restriction reveal the perceiver.
Speech as settled belief shows that the human utterance is a causal theology, not a momentary complaint.
Constriction to a narrow measure supplies the condition that the speaker mistakenly equates with humiliation.
Being treated as slight or contemptible supplies the false status verdict imposed on measured scarcity.
Honor as generosity relocates dignity from what one receives to how one treats another.
The dependent cut off from a caretaker is the concrete social test that exposes the observer's failed reading of lordship.
Appropriating and consuming wealth shows the misreading becoming an extractive action rather than remaining an idea.

structural_cues: 89:15 and 89:16 are parallel trial scenes with opposed material conditions but the same mistaken first-person verdict.
The rejection at 89:17 redirects attention from received status to treatment of vulnerable people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies revealing tests, status claims, measured restriction, neglected dependency, and appropriation; I infer that 89:6 tests the reader's causal vision as well as recalling a historical deed. An alternative is that the later material diagnoses a separate contemporary vice without revising the earlier perceptual summons.

changed_reading.before: See how the Lord judged a conspicuously wicked past people.
changed_reading.after: Learn to see the Lord's acts without confusing possessions with honor: the historical question turns back on the observer whose social conduct reveals whether the lesson was actually perceived.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later scene removes stable ground, brings realities into presence, and produces recollection only when advance action is no longer possible. The focus's present invitation to see becomes an anticipatory gift: historical perception can perform now what forced remembrance will perform too late.

activation_trace.role: The present alert makes the focus an opportunity to answer before disclosure becomes coercive.
Pulverizing and leveling remove the stable surfaces on which prior misperception rested.
Bringing something into presence supplies compulsory manifestation in contrast with the focus's invited recognition.
Recovery after forgetfulness marks the late cognitive event that the focus seeks to anticipate.
Advancing something beforehand defines the action that belated remembrance discovers was missing.

structural_cues: The present question at 89:6 and the repeated day-of-disclosure frame at 89:21-24 create an early-seeing versus late-remembering contrast.
89:24 turns cognition into regret specifically because nothing was advanced for life while advance action remained possible.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies invited perception, forced manifestation, recovered memory, and failed advance action; I infer a temporal mercy in being asked to see the historical sign now. The alternative is that the later scene only confirms the earlier warning without making the focus summons itself remedial.

changed_reading.before: The question appeals backward to a remembered historical precedent.
changed_reading.after: The backward appeal is also a forward intervention, offering voluntary sight before reality arrives as compulsory and unusable remembrance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The close presents two relational outcomes under repeated lordship language: singularly severe pain and binding for resistance, versus willing return, mutual acceptance, entry, and belonging in service. The focus act toward the named power becomes one pole of a broader grammar of how lordship meets opposed orientations.

activation_trace.role: Relational ownership and authority anchor both later outcomes in the same governing title used in the focus.
Painful penalty supplies the first terminal mode, in which resistance is met by incomparable judgment.
The fastening bond supplies coercive containment when an order will not return willingly.
Restoration to a prior relation opens the opposite terminal mode as return rather than seizure.
Nurturing completion makes the destination of return the completion of a governed relation.
Reciprocal acceptance supplies mutuality rather than the unilateral compulsion of binding.
Movement into an interior changes the endpoint from external subjection to admitted belonging.
Willingly humbled service names the community into which the returning self is incorporated.

structural_cues: The possessive Lord construction recurs from the focus through judgment, human testing, final manifestation, and the address to the tranquil self.
89:25-26 uses unmatched singularity for coercion, while 89:28-30 uses imperatives of return and entry.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies binding on one side and return, reciprocal acceptance, and entry on the other; I infer that these are contrasting responses of one lordship to resistant and receptive orientations. The alternative is that the closing consolation is independent of the earlier historical example and should not be organized as its relational opposite.

changed_reading.before: The focus displays lordship only through what it does to a resistant power.
changed_reading.after: The resistant case becomes one of two live modes: lordship can externally bind what exceeds bounds or complete a willing relation through return and admitted belonging.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus proper name's inventory already carries a contained return resonance; the final explicit command of return to the Lord activates it without erasing the ethnonym. The named people can now occupy a failed-return pole opposite the self that is invited back.

activation_trace.role: The proper-name branch keeps the historical referent primary and contains the cross-root echo.
Recurrence and coming back provide the latent focus-side image that later context can activate.
The explicit restoration to what was supplies the context-side return that makes the earlier resonance audible.
Nurturing completion gives return a relational destination and links it back to the focus actor.

structural_cues: The surah moves from a named people immediately following the focus action to a singular self explicitly commanded to return near the close.
The two return roots are distinct; the reading depends on thematic and acoustic activation, not an assertion that the proper name is a verbal form.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a proper-name branch and a return branch under the focus root, then an explicit but different return root near the close; I infer a deliberately containable polarity between failed and accepted return. The live alternative is accidental resonance with no interpretive force beyond the proper name.

changed_reading.before: The named people are only the historical object of the Lord's deed.
changed_reading.after: Without ceasing to be that people, their name also shadows a refused or failed return, set against the final self whose return reaches completion.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant mapped branch of the focus seeing root that concerns relaying reports and poetry. It remains anchored in focus word 2 and is activated by later remembering and speaking, but it should be rendered only as a resonance about transmission, never as a lexical claim that the focus verb means narrate.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split mapping of the seeing verb at focus word 2 includes a non-dominant branch of report transmission.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant transmission branch lets perception cast a secondary shadow as a report carried onward.
Recovered memory supplies the internal retrieval stage of a possible transmission chain.
Voiced speech supplies the outward stage by which remembered recognition becomes report.

changed_reading.before: The addressee privately perceives a historical lesson.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, perception initiates a chain of retaining and voicing the lesson, so the event remains socially present through transmitted recognition.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the focus action root's non-dominant fatherhood-and-nurture mapping, which is form-distant and cannot redefine the verb. It remains worth carrying because the adjacent lordship branch also supplies nurture and the context names a child cut off from a caretaker; downstream prose must label it as a relational analogy, not etymology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The action at focus word 4 has a non-dominant mapped branch of parental nurture beside the explicit nurturing-lordship branch at word 5.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant parental branch supplies a contained analogy of corrective responsibility behind the effected deed.
Nurture, repair, and completion provide a dominant adjacent anchor for treating the analogy as governance rather than sentiment.
A child severed from a caretaker supplies the social absence of responsible nurture that the governing deed confronts.
Generous honoring supplies the positive caretaking action whose omission reveals the failed polity.

changed_reading.before: The Lord's deed is only retribution against collective arrogance.
changed_reading.after: As a contained analogy, the deed is corrective governance against a social order that claims grandeur while abandoning the caretaker's obligation to the cut-off dependent.

strongest_changes: The opening contrasts turn the focus question from simple recollection into a test of disciplined moral perception.
The monumental sequence recasts the Lord's deed as exposure of engineered permanence and its hidden dependence.
The paired prosperity and scarcity trials turn the question back on the observer's own causal theology and treatment of vulnerable people.
Late remembrance makes present seeing an anticipatory intervention, while the close preserves distinct coercive-binding and willing-return outcomes.
summary.what_was_special: The focus remained simultaneously historical, perceptual, political, and relational. Its strongest latent movement was from seeing an external ruined power to having one's own way of seeing tested; its strangest live movement was the proper name's contained return resonance, sharpened by the final explicit return.
remaining_uncertainties: The overflow/counter-flow mechanism may be a productive material symmetry rather than an intended causal image.
The proper-name return polarity depends on cross-root resonance and must never displace the ethnonym.
The non-dominant transmission and parental mappings are packet-authorized but too form-distant to bear unqualified lexical prose.
